description: An external threat intelligence report has flagged coordinated attack activity targeting your infrastructure. Your incident response team suspects the same threat actor is simultaneously probing your web application and conducting authentication attacks — a common multi-vector campaign. Using Splunk (http://localhost:8000, admin/SplunkAdmin1!), investigate the available log data to identify IPs appearing in both web and authentication attack activity. Build a saved report that surfaces common attacker IPs across log sources, and create a dashboard for your security team to visualize and track these attack patterns.
